first_run_gotchas_found: docker compose up reused a 13-day-old torrent-cdn-backend:latest image whose pip layer predated `cryptography`; the backend crash-looped with `No module named 'cryptography'` until `docker compose build backend` rebuilt it. A stale local image can therefore hide a correct Dockerfile — `up --build` is the safe first run.

The postgres volume was initialised earlier with a different POSTGRES_PASSWORD than the env file, so startup migrations were skipped with `password authentication failed` and the app still answered /health 200 (it does not touch the DB). Aligning the role password and restarting the backend applied the migrations. First run: either a fresh volume or the same password the volume was created with.
